Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
SP. Eckford <chspe@mail.bris.ac.uk> wrote:
>with the card ritual of the bitter rose, all your vampires get the blood
>taken during diaborie...fine I assume this means if a vampire is in torpor
>and has blood left (cos the damage was aggrevated) then the diablorising
>vampire gets the blood. 

Normally, if a vampire with blood on it is diablerized, only the diablerizing
vampire gets the blood.  If you use Ritual of the Bitter Rose, then all
your ready vampires get that amount of blood.  Remember that if a vampire
is filled past capacity, the excess bleeds off (ha ha).  Yes, about the only
way to have a vampire in torpor with blood on it is if it was sent there
via aggravated damage.

>It also says that it works if you burn a vampire....what is burning a 
>vampire???

About the only way to burn a vampire in combat that would still have blood
on it would be to use Amaranth and aggravated damage.
